lane:
فغفور

فغفورى فَغْفُورِىٌّ [_China-ware,_ or _porcelain,_] the [_sort of_] خَزَف _that is brought from China;_ so called from فَغْفُور, [the title of] the king of China: vulgarly فَرْفُورِى. (TA in art. فر.)
